notes: Color Palette refresh repair on stable v0.2.29. Fixes Windows PowerShell's JSON-array unwrapping behavior so a one-color palette survives Notes refreshes exactly like a multi-color palette. The same reader fix also protects one-item Aliases, Tags, and Aesthetic Tags. Preserves permanent custom color-picker slots, custom Notes, Timeline, Story, Powers, launcher behavior, separate user data, and verified package hashes. Windows PowerShell tests passed for both one-item and multi-item swatch round trips before publish.
